comment: Synthesis-model campaign (MOJO_PORT.md 10.3). One entry per shipped model; budgets are the shipped budget_s values, so a native retrain gets the same wall time as the original (AI_LANES=1: 22,200 s of training plus evaluation, inside the 28,800 s cap). A stage may give iters instead of budget_s to make a model independent of the clock. Run: make train-ai-synth (train_all --campaign ...).
